name: Jugendzeltplatz Paulsteiner
beschreibung: The Jugendzeltplatz Paulsteiner is located in Finkenberg in the Zillertal. The surroundings are characterized by the high mountain landscape of the Zillertaler Alpen. In summer, numerous hiking trails serve as starting points for tours; in winter, the ski areas on the Penken and at the Hintertuxer Gletscher are easily reachable. The site is geared toward accommodating youth groups and school classes and offers simple, close-to-nature overnight accommodation. The facilities include tent meadows, sanitary facilities, and a common room. Guests should expect basic camping standards and appreciate the quiet, secluded location. From Finkenberg, the village of Mayrhofen and numerous excursion destinations in the Zillertal can be reached quickly.
